system: lpsocl (O-doped LPSCl1.6, 62at, POS3 unit) | Li bcc reservoir
method: UMA-s-1p1 MLIP-MD, 3 seeds x 100 ps, 600 K Langevin NVT, dt 1 fs, bottom-6A frozen. Protocol byte-identical to b2o3 campaign (run_interface_campaign.sh). Analyzer O-fingerprint added 2026-07-18 (O-P=POS3 intact, O-Li=Li2O).
control: modelc62 (SAME 62at 1x frame, one S->O reverted) from b2o3 campaign 2026-07-07 -> isolates the single O substitution. 1x slab absolute decomposition thin-slab inflated ~1.9x, but the lpsocl/modelc62 RATIO is clean (same frame).

ratio_lpsocl_over_modelc62.note: 0.85 < 1 = O marginally PROTECTS host; but 40.9+/-6.5 vs 48.1+/-7.8 overlaps -> read as 'O does NOT worsen the interface, marginally protective' (like b2o3).

headline.POS3_robust: P-O (POS3) unit stays 100% INTACT in ALL 3 seeds (O-P 1.00->1.00, POS3_loss 0%) through 100 ps at the reactive Li-metal interface -- while host P-S loses 41%. The strongest lattice bond (ICOHP P-O -8.41) holds even against Li metal.
headline.no_Li2O: O is NOT reduced to Li2O (O-Li rises only +0.33, stays P-anchored; Li2O would need O-P->0, O-Li->4-6). O stays bonded to P.
headline.host_not_worsened: PS4 decomposition RATIO 0.85 (within error of 1) -> O doping does not worsen the interface, marginally protective. Parallels b2o3 (BS3 intact, doping neutral-to-protective).
headline.mechanism: Consistent with today's ICOHP/Bader: P-O deepest covalent bond + O deepest charge -> POS3 is a robust, reduction-resistant anchor. Same electronic story across bulk (bond strength), transport (Li-trap raises Ea), and now anode interface (survives Li metal).

caveats: MLIP-level (UMA, no DFT validation of the reactive phases). 100 ps not self-limited (both still reacting -- absolute % is a time lower-bound; RATIO/POS3-intact are the robust reads). 1x thin slab (few P) inflates absolute PS_loss vs a 2x cell; comparison to modelc62 (same 1x frame) is clean.
